prompt: Close the Project-Target-Work information architecture by making Target the delivery unit inside Project, containing inherited Issues as Legacy Work, preserving classic behavior, and proving the result.
allowed_actions: Update canonical product, navigation, and Target read-model documentation
Change Project list and detail UI under the Verrail navigation flag
Preserve and relabel inherited Issue workflows as compatibility UI
Add focused service, component, route, and locale tests
Run the local stack and browser verification
Create B2.2 delivery records and an advisory review decision
forbidden_actions: Delete or silently migrate Issue data
Invent Target membership for legacy Issues
Move Target write authority outside Go
Break classic navigation or compatibility deep links
Commit, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without explicit user approval
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run server/src/__tests__/target-routes.test.ts ui/src/components/TargetList.test.tsx ui/src/App.test.tsx ui/src/i18n/locale-validation.test.ts
expected_evidence: Project navigation and compatibility behavior tests
Desktop and narrow browser screenshots and interaction checks
Advisory review decision with no self-approval
stop_conditions: The UI would need to infer a Target relationship absent from authoritative data
Target metrics cannot be calculated after authorization
Preserving legacy work would require changing Issue behavior
The change would move native Target authority outside the Go Domain API
